name: The Ritz Carlton Astana
positioning: The Ritz-Carlton, Astana is a city hotel near Baiterek Tower, with a Club Lounge, Italian dining and a rooftop with a private glass dome
best_for: Travelers who want a base within walking distance of Nurzhol Boulevard and Baiterek Tower
Guests who enjoy Italian dining and a Club Lounge

facts.text: The hotel is within walking distance of Nurzhol Boulevard and Baiterek Tower.
Mökki Restaurant serves traditional Italian cuisine with a touch of modernity, prepared by an Italian chef.
Mökki hosts brunch gatherings, master classes and guest chef visits.
Өzen Lobby Lounge & Terrace serves hand-crafted cocktails and afternoon tea.
Guest rooms and suites have Diptyque amenities.
The spa offers skincare treatments featuring the brands ESPA and Valmont.
The hotel offers Ritz Kids amenities for families with children.
Club Level guests have access to the Club Lounge on the 14th floor.
The Carlton Suite offers a private dining experience with panoramic views of Astana.

highlights.text: Rooftop at the hotel has a private glass dome and serves European cuisine.
Mökki Terrace is a summer dining terrace overlooking the Baiterek monument.
The hotel is steps from Baiterek Tower, the House of Ministries and the Central Business District.
The Club Lounge offers complimentary food and beverage presentations five times each day.
Panoramic windows in the rooms and suites frame Baiterek Tower.

considerations.text: Mökki Terrace is open May through September.
Club access requires an upgraded booking, and Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access to Club.
The airport is approximately 12.9 km from the hotel.

sources.title: Condé Nast Traveler: The Ritz-Carlton, Astana
